english.title: Person subject to director disqualification sanctions act as director/take part in/concerned in company
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person subject to director disqualification sanctions

(A)_[acted as director]_
(B)_[directly or indirectly took part in or were concerned in the promotion, formation or management]_

of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11A and 13 of the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The offence in section 11A(1) of the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 does not apply where an exception has been created or to anything done under the authority of a licence issued under section 15(3A) of the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018.
(ii) There is a defence for a person charged with this offence to prove that they did not know and could not reasonably have been expected to know they were subject to director disqualifications sanctions at the time they engaged in the conduct, under section 11A(3).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
